# @arki/content-build

> Build-time content pipeline: content-collections config, preset collections (posts, legal pages, FAQs, changelog), a Vite plugin and the `arki-content` CLI.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/content-build/config`: `addIdToHeadings`, `compileMDX`, `compileMarkdown`, `defineCollection`, `defineContentConfig`, `resolveImageBlurDataURL`; types `CompileMarkdownOptions`, `CompiledMarkdown`, `GetTypeByName`, `MarkdownHeading`, `Meta`.
- `@arki/content-build/presets`: `changelogs`, `faqs`, `legals`, `marketing`, `posts`; types `Changelog`, `Faq`, `Legal`, `Post`.
- `@arki/content-build/vite`: `contentPlugin`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Start here
- [README](README.md): compiling plain markdown with `compileMarkdown`.

## By task
- Compile GitHub markdown (READMEs, docs) to HTML: `compileMarkdown` from `@arki/content-build/config`. It returns `html` and `headings`.
- Define collections: use the preset collections from `@arki/content-build/presets`.
- Wire the build into Vite: `@arki/content-build/vite`.

## Rules that bite
- `compileMarkdown` is plain markdown, not MDX. MDX fails on `<` and `{` in prose, plain markdown keeps them as text.
- Use `rewriteLink` to turn relative `./x.md` links into site routes.
- The collections it generates are read by `@arki/content` and rendered by `@arki/content-react`.
